_doc: Inputs the gate (diffemu_gfx.py) holds fixed for a function instead of fuzzing them, each with why. zero_ranges: [address, bytes] written as zero after the fuzzed globals. A verdict under such inputs carries `inputs_limited` (the note), and the tree's GATE line says so: it covers only the paths these inputs reach.

0x10016320.note: the object-pointer table 0x10456A00..0x10456A27, g_pApp and g_pCDx held empty: for each non-null one the function calls slot 6 (+0x18) of its vtable (0x10016330, 0x10016358, 0x10016373), a destructor of a class the gate has no model of, so a fuzzed pointer makes the original jump to arbitrary code; compared: the empty-slot paths and the three direct calls

0x10003890.note: the entity table 0x10480AF0 (0x900 pointers) held empty: for each listed entity the function calls slot 102 (+0x198) and +0x1BC of the actor at entity+0xA0 (0x10003A50, 0x10003A6D), methods of classes the gate has no model of, so a fuzzed table makes the original jump to arbitrary code; compared: the paths where the entity slots are empty, and everything else the function does
